title: Normalized completed coefficient monoidal adjunction transport models
statement: With the prime, coefficient rings, module-sheaf derived categories and site and tensor presentations of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-tensor-transport-models], define a normalized completed-coefficient monoidal adjunction transport datum for a family of schemes $W_a$. For every morphism $f:W_a\to W_b$, choose the already recorded completed/constant pushforward comparison presentation [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models], with its source and target exact restrictions equal to the chosen site restrictions. Choose ordinary left adjoints to its actual ringed and constant module pushforwards and representative-normalized derived adjunction presentations [def-pur-ringed-coefficient-counit-presentations]; their right functors and universal units must equal the recorded right-image models. The constant inverse image is exact, and ringed pullback computes on every flat-term K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex] [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Include an isomorphism from completion of ordinary derived ringed pullback to the specified strict-quotient pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Normalize it on every good representative by a chain augmentation into the actual pullback Roos cone [def-pur-integral-operation-complex-models] of the strict pullback tower [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower]: its product component is the compatible family whose ordinary adjoints send a section to its reduction followed by the finite pullback scalar-unit generator [def-pur-integral-finite-pullback], and its shifted-product component is zero; the derived comparison composed with the actual completion unit equals this augmentation via the universal derived comparison. Define $\kappa$ by the recorded coefficient comparison, transported only along the equalities of models. Define the ordinary scalar unit and its derived version $\tau$ as the adjunction mates of the corresponding sectionwise-identity and derived $\kappa$ squares; require their K-flat representative equation. Lift completed pullbacks and complete-preserving direct images to the complete full subcategories. Include completed adjunctions whose Hom bijections are ordinary adjunction after precomposition by the actual completion unit and whose counits satisfy $\eta\,\varepsilon^c=\varepsilon$. Include $b:\widehat f_A^*U\simeq U\widehat f_R^*$ with $b\eta^A=U\eta^R\tau$, the ordinary counit identity, the completed counit identity $b\,U\varepsilon_R^c=\widehat f_A^*(\kappa)\,\varepsilon_A^c$, equality of inverse Hom bijections under $U,b,\kappa$, and the resulting unit identity. Include ordinary pullback strong tensorators for the recorded tensor models [def-zl-ringed-site-duality-model], fixed on total-complex representatives by the tensor of the ordinary adjunction units on homogeneous local generators. This defines the per-arrow data and ordinary representative tensor comparison; no existence is asserted.
